aggregation: two-recording equal macro separately per weighting
all three individual seeds; mean and sample SD ddof1

bootstrap.CI: percentile 2.5/97.5, 2000 paired cluster bootstrap draws; descriptive, not independence or exposure correction
bootstrap.common_draws: same sampled cluster-index matrix for ADE/FDE, both weightings and all three metric families within a recording/training-seed
bootstrap.groups: all frozen history groups reported descriptively; bootstrap main whole recording only, no subgroup significance searches
bootstrap.person_equal: mean selected within-person mean paired errors
bootstrap.unit: recording-local person ID; sample n_person IDs with replacement; keep all windows for each selected ID multiplicity
bootstrap.window_weighted: sum cluster error sums with multiplicity / sum cluster window counts with multiplicity

checkpoint_policy: epoch1/25/50/75/100 immutable periodic snapshots plus selected best serialized in RAM on each improvement and written once at completion; last=epoch100; no old or per-epoch artifact overwritten
embargo: exact Stage5.1 train/dev support; no held-recording train and no promotion of old validation

evaluation.K20: independent ADE and FDE minima per target; first sample is candidate0
evaluation.every_epoch: full validation all metrics plus original supervised posterior objective; same per-target noise across epochs
evaluation.method: external evaluation-only Gaussian standard-noise provider through temporary distribution hooks; original loc/scale, forward, parameters and loss unchanged; remove hooks before training
evaluation.prior: original deterministic latent-prior-mean trajectory, not expectation over predicted trajectories
evaluation.seed_rule: namespace unchanged; identity contains run_seed 17/42/2026. Seed17 must exactly reproduce frozen evaluator; same seed Full/Placebo share epsilons

failure_policy: first nonfinite stops affected run and saves failure payload; no hyperparameter retry; other frozen runs still execute

history_groups.support: only raw eight-frame positions and masks, never future error; keep all/empty groups

initialization: seed_all(run_seed) before frozen model constructor; verify all shared tensors and post-construction RNG exactly equal for Full/Placebo per seed before training
loss: unchanged official mean reconstruction + Monte Carlo latent KL mean; not exact marginal NLL
model_selection: minimum validation target-window-weighted K1 latent-prior ADE; exact tie earlier epoch; FDE from same checkpoint

scheduling.caveat: independent processes/RNG; shared single GPU, run wall times include contention; configuration never changes after observing seed42
scheduling.ordered_queue_per_model: seed42 ZARA2, seed42 HOTEL, seed2026 ZARA2, seed2026 HOTEL

small_group.rule: flag if either; retain empty groups with null metrics

stability.ADE_FDE_conflict: ADE consistently negative but FDE not: ADE-only evidence, explicitly conflicting; no joint performance claim
stability.magnitude: report mean paired delta, sample SD of deltas and per-model across-seed errors; no significance decision from n=3 or chosen SNR cutoff
stability.primary: best K1 latent-prior ADE paired Full-minus-Placebo; strict negative indicates Full better
stability.stronger_development_evidence: all 3 seeds x 2 recordings x 2 weightings have negative ADE deltas; paired FDE must also be negative for joint ADE/FDE support
stability.unstable: any ADE direction reversal across seeds in any recording/weighting: current benefit not stable, stop complex social-module development

synthetic_context.acceleration: successive synthetic displacement differences; boundary zero placeholders ignored by official initialization
synthetic_context.causality: each synthetic frame uses target prefix only
synthetic_context.distribution_caveat: four always-available near neighbors vs variable real count/entry/missing velocity; fixed cardinal directions and bounded drift change inductive bias; initial relative offsets are constant, not equal function-class capacity
synthetic_context.future: all twelve future neighbor slots are 1e9 padding, including training posterior
synthetic_context.velocity: successive synthetic position differences, per-step displacement as official API

training_order: numpy default_rng(run_seed+epoch).permutation(all train targets), retain final partial batch, exactly one complete pass
